package.name: rover_modbus
package.description:
Modbus TCP frame codec and POSIX socket client.
Vendored fork of Mazurel/Modbus (MIT). Ships two targets: Modbus_Core (the OS-independent request/response/exception/CRC codec) and Modbus_Tcp (the POSIX socket client and server). The split lets consumers that only build frames link the codec without dragging in sockets.
package.author: Mateusz Mazur
